avis.texte: Truly the best cleanser I've ever used. I'm on my third tube.

avis.titre: Really calming and a deep clean!
avis.texte: This was an unexpected love! It really does give a deep clean without overly stripping, and the tea tree does help for calming redness. It's especially nice as a second step in a double cleanse. Might not be great for dryer skin types, but if you're oily, definitely give it a try!
